turns.content: For a right circular cone with base radius r and height h, write the volume formula.
Differentiate the cone-volume formula with respect to r and h to obtain the line integral dV.
For r = 10 cm and h = 25 cm, with |dr| ≤ 0.1 cm and |dh| ≤ 0.1 cm, calculate the two absolute-error components.
A subsequent worksheet step records the height-error contribution as (10/3)π cm³. Use the recorded component in the subsequent error analysis.
Treat the two component magnitudes as deterministic error bounds. Has any probability, independence, or correlation model been supplied?
Using the sign check from the previous turn, report the entropy-production estimate both exactly and approximately, with its unit and first-order qualification.
